target_audience: Korean brands and franchises expanding into the U.S. market.
language: Korean ONLY (All text, navigation, headings, body, and UI elements must be generated in Korean by the main agent. Do not use English unless for stylistic micro-labels like 'EST. 2026').
design_philosophy: Museum-grade restraint, luxury editorial, cinematic visuals. Awwwards SOTD level. Aesthetic reflects high-end professional services, private wealth advisory, or boutique commercial real estate. Avoid bright startup colors. Emphasize trust, real-world experience, and premium execution.

scale.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold text-accent_gold

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous white space, highly structured grids, editorial asymmetry. Padding should be 2x standard (e.g., py-24 or py-32 for sections).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for copy to mimic high-end magazines. Center-alignment reserved strictly for specific visual breaks.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Use 1px borders using 'border_subtle' to divide sections elegantly without heavy shadows.

key_features_and_pages.home_hero: Kinetic typography. Background must be deep navy/black overlay on a subtle parallax city skyline. Text must use Framer Motion for a masked line-by-line reveal (translateY from 100% to 0 with overflow-hidden on parent).
key_features_and_pages.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, elegant editorial drift. Large Noto Serif KR text, italicized, low contrast (e.g., pale grey text on bone-white background).
key_features_and_pages.manifesto: Numbered chapters for About Us and Services. Huge Noto Serif KR numbers (e.g., '01', '02') in gold, acting as structural graphic elements alongside text.
key_features_and_pages.services_pillars: 4 Pillars bento grid. The 4th pillar ('Commercial Real Estate & Site Selection') MUST carry more visual weight: make it span 2 columns/rows or give it a prominent clipped image.
key_features_and_pages.process_flow: 6-step visual flow. Step 4 ('Site Selection') must be highlighted (e.g., active state, gold borders, or larger node) to show it's the core differentiator.
key_features_and_pages.editorial_photos: Images must have 'spotlight' treatment or clipped frames (e.g., sharp corners rounded-none, slight inset borders). No generic drop shadows.
key_features_and_pages.contact_form: Premium fields. Only bottom borders for inputs (border-b), transparent backgrounds. No standard generic boxes. Must integrate with MongoDB.
key_features_and_pages.blog_insights: CMS-backed (MongoDB) grid structure. Editorial cards with sharp corners and elegant typography.

motion_and_interaction.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium momentum feel.
motion_and_interaction.reveals: Every section must use Framer Motion 'whileInView' with a subtle 40px Y-axis lift and opacity fade.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Subtle and luxurious. Image zooms within clipped boundaries (overflow-hidden). Text color shifts to gold.

components_strategy.nav: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-primary_navy/80). Include a language toggle UI (Korean active). Logo in Serif. Gold CTA button.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp pill or completely square. If solid, use primary_navy with gold text. Hover should add a subtle glow or fill transition.
components_strategy.faq: Accordion style using Shadcn, styled minimalistically with 1px bottom borders.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: ALL content, headings, and labels MUST be in Korean.
Ensure high contrast ratios per APCA/WCAG standards.
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap text.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, and forms.
NO EMOJIS for icons. Use lucide-react.
Avoid generic centered startup-style layouts. Lean heavily into editorial luxury.
